$$
a(n) = 
\begin{cases}

a(n-1) + 1297 & \text{if } n = 8
\end{cases}
$$

This captures the standard increment of 127 for all $ n \geq 1 $, with a special case at $ n = 8 $ where the increment is 1297.

$$
a(0) = 7
$$
